allShows.title: Ben 10
allShows.description: A young boy named Ben discovers a mysterious alien watch that lets him transform into ten different heroes. With each form offering unique powers, Ben battles villains, saves the world from galactic threats, and learns the true meaning of responsibility.

episodes.title: The Day of the Omnitrix
episodes.synopsis: Ben discovers the Omnitrix and transforms into his first alien.

episodes.title: Welcome to the Tennyson Family
episodes.synopsis: Ben learns more about the Omnitrix and his new responsibilities.

episodes.title: First Big Battle
episodes.synopsis: Ben faces a dangerous rival in his first big fight.

episodes.title: A New Threat
episodes.synopsis: A new villain forces Ben to push his powers further.

episodes.title: Allies & Enemies
episodes.synopsis: Allies arrive, and Ben must choose who to trust.

allShows.title: Chhota Bheem
allShows.description: In the kingdom of Dholakpur, Bheem is a brave and kind-hearted boy with incredible strength. Along with his friends, he takes on villains, monsters, and tricky situations, proving that wisdom and courage always win the day.

episodes.title: The Festival Trouble
episodes.synopsis: Bheem and friends save the village festival from mischief.

episodes.title: The Stolen Treasure
episodes.synopsis: An ancient treasure goes missing and Bheem leads the search.

episodes.title: The Forest Guardian
episodes.synopsis: Bheem meets a guardian spirit protecting the forest.

episodes.title: The Giant Ganesha
episodes.synopsis: A giant mechanical Ganesha threatens the town and Bheem must stop it.

allShows.title: Courage: The Cowardly Dog
allShows.description: Courage may be timid, but when supernatural forces threaten his owners Muriel and Eustace, he finds the bravery to fight back. From creepy monsters to bizarre aliens, Courage protects his home in the middle of Nowhere with hilarious yet spooky encounters.

episodes.title: A New Strange Neighbor
episodes.synopsis: Courage encounters a strange neighbor with mysterious powers.

episodes.title: The Phantom of Nowhere
episodes.synopsis: Phantoms haunt the farmhouse and Courage must protect his family.

episodes.title: Alien Intrusion
episodes.synopsis: A spaceship lands nearby and Courage must save Muriel.

episodes.title: The Curse of the Mask
episodes.synopsis: A cursed mask brings nightmares to the farmhouse.

allShows.title: Doraemon
allShows.description: A robotic cat from the 22nd century, Doraemon, travels back in time to help Nobita. Using futuristic gadgets, he tries to fix Nobita’s everyday problems, but often ends up in funny and chaotic adventures with his friends.

episodes.title: Gadget Troubles
episodes.synopsis: Doraemon uses a new gadget and things go haywire.

episodes.title: Time Travel Trouble
episodes.synopsis: A time-travel mistake sends Nobita into the past.

episodes.title: Gadget Mixup
episodes.synopsis: A gadget swap causes unexpected chaos.

episodes.title: The Lost Robot
episodes.synopsis: Doraemon's memory card goes missing and chaos ensues.

episodes.title: Gadget Carnival
episodes.synopsis: A gadget festival gets out of hand with crazy inventions.

allShows.title: Jake and the Never Land Pirates
allShows.description: Jake and his crew of young pirates set sail across Never Land, facing challenges and collecting treasures. Together they outsmart the mischievous Captain Hook, proving that teamwork and friendship make them true pirates of adventure.

episodes.title: Treasure Hunt
episodes.synopsis: Jake's crew hunts for a hidden treasure on Never Land.

episodes.title: Captain Hook's Return
episodes.synopsis: Captain Hook plots a new scheme to steal Jake's treasure map.

episodes.title: Island Rescue
episodes.synopsis: Jake rescues a stranded friend from a spooky island.

episodes.title: Treasure Map Riddle
episodes.synopsis: A clever riddle reveals the next treasure location.

allShows.title: Kick Buttowski
allShows.description: Clarence “Kick” Buttowski dreams of being the world’s greatest daredevil. With fearless stunts, wild challenges, and endless determination, Kick constantly pushes the limits of danger and comedy in his small suburban town.

episodes.title: Daredevil Debut
episodes.synopsis: Kick attempts a daring stunt to impress the town.

episodes.title: Ramp of Doom
episodes.synopsis: A crazy ramp challenge puts Kick to the test.

episodes.title: Extreme Weekend
episodes.synopsis: Kick enters an extreme sports weekend competition.

episodes.title: Neighborhood Showdown
episodes.synopsis: A hometown showdown determines who is the bravest.

allShows.title: Kid vs Kat
allShows.description: When Coop’s sister adopts a strange hairless cat, life takes a turn for chaos. The cat is actually an evil alien plotting world domination, and Coop becomes the only one who knows the truth—leading to a never-ending battle of wits.

episodes.title: Alien Pet
episodes.synopsis: Coop discovers Kat's alien origins.

episodes.title: Gadget Mayhem
episodes.synopsis: Kat's gadgets create chaos in the neighborhood.

episodes.title: Coop's Revenge
episodes.synopsis: Coop fights back using clever traps.

episodes.title: The Great Escape
episodes.synopsis: Kat escapes and Coop must capture him again.

allShows.title: Kiteretsu
allShows.description: Kiteretsu is a boy genius who builds amazing inventions inspired by his ancestor’s encyclopedia. Along with his robot friend Korosuke, he explores science, friendship, and wild adventures that mix comedy with clever problem-solving.

episodes.title: Invention #1
episodes.synopsis: Kiteretsu builds a helpful invention.

episodes.title: Robot Friend
episodes.synopsis: Kiteretsu meets and repairs a robot friend.

episodes.title: Treasure of Science
episodes.synopsis: A scientific treasure hunt begins.

episodes.title: Time Machine
episodes.synopsis: Kiteretsu experiments with a time device.

allShows.title: Mickey Mouse Clubhouse
allShows.description: Mickey and his friends invite kids into a colorful clubhouse filled with fun, friendship, and problem-solving. Together with Minnie, Donald, Daisy, Goofy, and Pluto, Mickey uses teamwork and creativity to solve everyday challenges in magical ways.

episodes.title: Clubhouse Adventure
episodes.synopsis: Mickey and friends solve a puzzle at the clubhouse.

episodes.title: The Missing Map
episodes.synopsis: A treasure map goes missing and teamwork saves the day.

episodes.title: Goofy's Big Plan
episodes.synopsis: Goofy leads a big plan that almost fails but succeeds.

episodes.title: Donald's Surprise
episodes.synopsis: Donald prepares a surprise that becomes a lesson in patience.

allShows.title: Mr. Bean
allShows.description: Mr. Bean is eccentric, childlike, and hilariously unpredictable. With little dialogue and plenty of slapstick, he stumbles into ordinary situations that quickly spiral into chaotic misadventures, leaving laughter in his wake.

episodes.title: Bean's Trouble
episodes.synopsis: Mr. Bean faces everyday trouble with hilarious solutions.

episodes.title: Cinema Chaos
episodes.synopsis: Bean's trip to the cinema turns into a disaster.

episodes.title: The Accident
episodes.synopsis: A small accident leads to a domino of misfortunes.

allShows.title: Ninja Hattori
allShows.description: Hattori is a skilled young ninja who comes to live with Kenichi, a mischievous schoolboy. Using his ninja skills, Hattori helps Kenichi with school, friends, and life’s problems, while also battling rival ninjas who threaten peace.

episodes.title: The New Ninja
episodes.synopsis: Hattori arrives and teaches Kenichi a lesson.

episodes.title: Training Day
episodes.synopsis: Kenichi learns basic ninja techniques.

episodes.title: Small Mission
episodes.synopsis: Hattori completes a small mission for a neighbor.

episodes.title: Rival Ninja
episodes.synopsis: A rival threatens the town and a duel is set.

episodes.title: The Lost Scroll
episodes.synopsis: A scroll containing secret techniques is stolen.

allShows.title: Oggy and the Cockroaches
allShows.description: Oggy, a lazy cat, just wants to relax and enjoy life, but three pesky cockroaches—Joey, Dee Dee, and Marky—never let him. Their endless pranks lead to hilarious chases, over-the-top chaos, and slapstick comedy in every episode.

episodes.title: Cockroach Mayhem
episodes.synopsis: Oggy battles the cockroaches in comedic fashion.

episodes.title: Kitchen Chaos
episodes.synopsis: The kitchen becomes a battleground for food and pranks.

episodes.title: Holiday Havoc
episodes.synopsis: A holiday special ends up in disaster for Oggy.

episodes.title: Giant Roach
episodes.synopsis: A giant cockroach causes panic across town.

allShows.title: Oswald
allShows.description: Oswald the gentle octopus lives in Big City with his pet dog, Weenie. His calm and kind nature brings life lessons of patience, friendship, and positivity as he faces small adventures in everyday life.

episodes.title: Big City Day
episodes.synopsis: Oswald explores Big City and helps a friend.

episodes.title: The Garden
episodes.synopsis: Oswald helps grow a garden for the neighborhood.

episodes.title: Music Day
episodes.synopsis: A music festival brings friends together.

allShows.title: Perman
allShows.description: Mitsuo, a young boy, is chosen to become “Perman,” a superhero who fights crime with special gadgets and powers. Balancing his double life as both a student and a hero, Mitsuo learns the importance of responsibility and courage.

episodes.title: Becoming Perman
episodes.synopsis: Mitsuo receives powers and learns his duty.

episodes.title: Robot Menace
episodes.synopsis: Robots threaten the city and Perman intervenes.

episodes.title: Power Test
episodes.synopsis: Perman's powers are tested by a cunning foe.

allShows.title: Phineas and Ferb
allShows.description: Stepbrothers Phineas and Ferb spend every summer day creating outrageous inventions and wild projects. Meanwhile, their sister Candace tries to expose them, and their pet platypus Perry secretly lives a double life as a spy fighting evil Dr. Doofenshmirtz.

episodes.title: The Big Invention
episodes.synopsis: Phineas and Ferb build an incredible invention.

episodes.title: Roller Coaster Day
episodes.synopsis: A massive roller coaster takes Phineas and Ferb's fun to new heights.

episodes.title: The Great Escape
episodes.synopsis: An escape plan goes hilariously wrong.

allShows.title: Pokemon
allShows.description: Join Ash Ketchum and his loyal Pikachu as they travel across regions to become Pokémon Masters. Along the way, they meet new friends, battle rivals, discover legendary creatures, and learn that true strength comes from friendship and teamwork.

episodes.title: Pallet Town Begins
episodes.synopsis: Ash gets Pikachu and begins his journey.

episodes.title: New Regions
episodes.synopsis: Ash heads to new regions and meets new friends.

episodes.title: Rival Encounter
episodes.synopsis: Ash faces a tough rival trainer.

allShows.title: Roll No 21
allShows.description: Kris, the modern-day avatar of Lord Krishna, battles evil in his school while disguising himself as an ordinary student. With clever tricks and divine wisdom, he defeats his enemy Kanishk and proves that good always triumphs over evil.

episodes.title: New Student Kris
episodes.synopsis: Kris reveals his divine side to protect classmates.

episodes.title: School Fair
episodes.synopsis: Kris uses tricks to save the school fair.

episodes.title: Divine Challenge
episodes.synopsis: A difficult challenge tests Kris' faith and cunning.

allShows.title: Shaun the Sheep
allShows.description: Shaun is a clever sheep who leads his flock into comical adventures on a quiet farm. From mischievous tricks to clever escapes, Shaun’s leadership often drags the farmer and the sheepdog Bitzer into lighthearted chaos.

episodes.title: Farm Follies
episodes.synopsis: Shaun leads the flock into a comedic adventure.

episodes.title: Holiday Hijinks
episodes.synopsis: Shaun prepares a holiday surprise with chaotic results.

episodes.title: The Big Escape
episodes.synopsis: A daring escape plan tests Shaun's leadership.

allShows.title: Shinchan
allShows.description: Shinchan is a mischievous five-year-old whose wild antics drive his parents, teachers, and neighbors crazy. With cheeky humor, silly jokes, and unpredictable adventures, he manages to turn every ordinary day into pure comedy.

episodes.title: Classroom Chaos
episodes.synopsis: Shinchan causes hilarity at school.

episodes.title: Holiday Trouble
episodes.synopsis: Shinchan ruins a family holiday in typical fashion.

episodes.title: Neighborhood Show
episodes.synopsis: Shinchan performs in a neighborhood show with unexpected results.

allShows.title: SpongeBob Square Pants
allShows.description: In the underwater city of Bikini Bottom, SpongeBob works at the Krusty Krab and goes on absurd adventures with his best friend Patrick. From jellyfishing to facing Plankton’s schemes, SpongeBob’s endless optimism makes every day hilariously unpredictable.

episodes.title: First Day at Work
episodes.synopsis: SpongeBob starts working at the Krusty Krab.

episodes.title: Jellyfishing Fun
episodes.synopsis: SpongeBob and Patrick go jellyfishing with chaotic results.

episodes.title: Bubble Trouble
episodes.synopsis: A playful bubble contest gets out of hand.

episodes.title: Plankton's Plan
episodes.synopsis: Plankton tries a new scheme to steal the Krabby Patty secret formula.

episodes.title: Sandy's Invention
episodes.synopsis: Sandy introduces a new invention for Bikini Bottom.

allShows.title: Strawberry Shortcake
allShows.description: In the sweet and colorful world of Strawberryland, Strawberry Shortcake and her friends go on heartwarming adventures. With lessons in kindness, friendship, and positivity, their journeys are as delightful as the desserts they love.

episodes.title: Strawberry Day
episodes.synopsis: Strawberry Shortcake organizes a festival for friends.

episodes.title: Friendship Picnic
episodes.synopsis: A picnic strengthens friendships and solves problems.

episodes.title: Berry Rescue
episodes.synopsis: A rescue mission brings the town together.

allShows.title: Tom and Jerry
allShows.description: One of the most iconic rivalries in animation, Tom the cat and Jerry the mouse engage in endless chases, traps, and slapstick comedy. Their timeless battles, filled with clever gags and explosive humor, remain a classic for all ages.

episodes.title: Cat & Mouse Chaos
episodes.synopsis: Tom chases Jerry through a classic mishap.

episodes.title: The Great Chase
episodes.synopsis: A chase sequence escalates to ridiculous extremes.

episodes.title: Mouse Mischief
episodes.synopsis: Jerry pulls a trick that backfires on Tom.

episodes.title: Mischief Mansion
episodes.synopsis: Tom's antics cause trouble at a grand mansion.

episodes.title: The Big Trap
episodes.synopsis: A massive trap scheme backfires spectacularly.
